points.modernName: Santa Rosa archaeological locality, upper Grijalva
points.rationale: Santa Rosa archaeological locality, upper Grijalva. Proposed by John L. Sorenson. Reconstructed from published figure's 257.60 km / 127.58 degree Santa Rosa to Kaminaljuyu measurement and rounded Kaminaljuyu coordinate using spherical geodesy. Approximate; many modern Santa Rosa localities are unrelated. Archaeological location at Grijalva/Aguacate junction per Brockington 1967 p1.
